reviews.text: Great place for pet stuff

A paradise for butlers

My master only plays with toys bought in Japan, so I make sure to stop by a pet store whenever I visit.

I think this is the best pet store in Tokyo.

It has the widest variety, is spacious, and is great.

They also offer tax-free shopping on the 3rd floor (Korean staff are always on hand).

Since it is located near the Odaiba Aquarium and the seaside park, it would be a good place to visit while sightseeing.
This is like the hub for dog and cat mama. A lots of supplement, jerky, food and pet stuffs. One more thing is that there is not much options for large sized dog.
I really wish they'd stop aggressively pushing options on us at the grooming salon... Damn you, Aeon...

I went to buy pet supplies.

I thought Japan has strict rules about taking photos,

so I paid first and then asked if I could take pictures, wanting to make a keepsake.

The shopkeeper said no, so we didn't take any.

Unexpectedly, a shop assistant whispered to me, "These are all Chinese people..."

It's funny... Chinese people might just take pictures without asking. I'm Taiwanese, and I asked first. If it wasn't allowed, I didn't take any pictures...

Is it acceptable for a shop assistant to comment on a customer like that?

Are these polite Japanese people?

After visiting a few pet store in central Tokyo that have very limited selection, shopping at PETEMO was so much fun.
They have an extensive selection of cat food, treats, litter, toys, harnesses and leashes, bed and even pop-up stores.
The cat food selection was very impressive - I especially enjoyed the Japan-special variants.
The shop is also tax-free for tourists!

I went to this pet store on the evening of July 25th. The puppy was so cute!

The overall environment was very clean and comfortable.

Most importantly, I really liked one of the female staff members.
She picked up the puppy, waved to me, and even came over to chat with me.

Even though I'm not Japanese or a potential customer, she was still so enthusiastic! 😭😭😭 This is one of my best memories from my trip to Japan! 🥰

Fantastic pet store with an amazing selection!
I was really impressed by the variety of products available. They have a huge selection of premium dog food, treats, toys, accessories, grooming products, and everything you could possibly need for your pet. I found some excellent products for my dog that are difficult to find elsewhere.
The store is clean, well organized, and enjoyable to browse. The staff were friendly and the overall shopping experience was excellent.
If you're visiting Odaiba and looking for quality products for your pet, I definitely recommend stopping by. I'll certainly be back on my next visit to Tokyo! 🐶🇯🇵
I found the AIM30 crackers I was looking for for my cat, thank you!

I was shocked by how unfriendly the staff were.

I shopped there to get a parking discount, but I won't be using their services again.

My child brought me to this city by train to buy toys as gifts for our cat back in Thailand. This is a pet supply store, and all I saw was products for dogs and cats. They had a huge selection of pet supplies, including clothing, food, and toys in many different styles. There were also many small puppies happily jumping and playing in cages, and several "for sale" signs. From what I saw, the prices were around 400,000 yen and up. Each puppy was incredibly cute.

It's spacious and easy to navigate. The staff were all very friendly and kind. For dog owners, it's safe to say you can find everything you need here. You can even shop with your dog, and there's a small dog run outside. You just need to bring your dog's vaccination and rabies certificates.

I was deciding between buying a pet cart from Fikago and AirBuggy Wizx, so I went to the store after hearing that they actually had both in stock.

The person who answered my phone call the day before was incredibly polite and kind. 💓
It would have been thousands of yen cheaper to buy online, but the customer service was excellent, even without seeing the person in person, so I decided to buy from Petemo and headed straight to the store the next day.

The sales associate who helped me at the cart counter that day was also incredibly kind! ✨
The explanation comparing the two models I was considering was very easy to understand, and it was a great purchase.♫

I'd definitely like to go back again! ✨
The female staff member's attitude was not good. When I asked, "Where is this?" she simply replied, "It's over there." I think she should be properly trained.

A shop that stocks clothes, food, and miscellaneous goods for both dogs and cats.
It's always bustling, but the store is spacious, so it doesn't feel too cramped.
The clothes are so cute, it's easy to loosen your purse strings...
It looks more like a store with amazing pet clothes, as there isn't a wide variety of accessories.

The selection of toys is vast, and most are cheaper than online. However, harnesses, leashes, and bedding are mostly for small dogs or dogs under 15 kg. The deodorizing and cleaning products are quite diverse; I'm really looking forward to using them!

For tax refunds, you need to go to the tax refund counter on another floor and download the designated app – "Pie Vat". The counter has step-by-step instructions; you need to bring all the items for refund, receipts, passport, and credit card (the passport name and credit card name must match). After completing the steps, the refund will be directly credited to the credit card entered in the app a few days later; it's not an instant refund!
Complete pet shops (foods, toys and etc.)
There seems to be a lot to choose from, I'll go buy some next time!

Thank you for your hospitality.

We stayed with our dog.

It was absolutely perfect.

We were so grateful that many of the staff were dog lovers.

The room was incredibly clean.

Everything a dog needs is provided.

A bed and diapers are fine.
Pet shop located on the 1st floor of Aqua City

As one of the largest stores in Tokyo, there is a wide selection of products, so you can shop at your leisure. 
I was happy to see snacks that are hard to find elsewhere.

They looked after my dog ​​while I went shopping.

They kept me updated on how my dog ​​was doing while I was there,
and they were very considerate when I called to make a reservation in advance.

I'll definitely use their services again when I visit Odaiba.
Very big pet store everything for pets can be found here. But it pretty far from the monorail station but walkalble with nice view of odaiba.

I went to buy a birthday present at the beginning of April. I bought teriyaki, small chicken, and a roll cake 🍰.
Since the birthday is April 24th, I put them in the freezer.
But when I went to feed them today, I found out the expiration date was April 17th! I couldn't believe it. I didn't check the expiration date, but I thought frozen food had a long shelf life, so I picked the top two. I also gave one to a friend. Her birthday is April 20th, and I gave her an expired present.
I wish they would ask, "Is this okay, the expiration date is this?" I had no idea the expiration date was so close. Normally, if something is about to expire, they'd sell it cheaper, or at least mention the proximity.
It's my fault for not checking carefully, but I'm surprised they're selling cakes and food with such a short shelf life.
It's a shame because it was one of my favorite stores.
I'm now debating whether to eat the expired cake.
Please don't stock food with such short expiration dates. 💢
💢 Please check the expiration date.

I stop by every time I come to Tokyo~

The store is big and there is lots to see~

The selection of products is fantastic. They sell a wide variety of items, and the store is spacious and easy to shop in compared to other pet shops in Tokyo. I was glad I could buy various things for my picky eater dog.

It was large, so there was a lot going on.

Nothing particularly memorable happened, but there were a lot of people with dogs.

I went to a grooming salon. The staff seemed to really love dogs and were very friendly, and the results were not bad.
However, the pricing system was a bit confusing, and while I thought I could get a cheaper deal by using a first-time coupon, it ended up being quite expensive. They tried to sell me on shampooing and recommended the most expensive plan, and I thought it would be good for my adorable dog, but in the end, the price was much cheaper than getting my dog ​​groomed at another private salon. They didn't offer any cute ribbons or other extras, and there were some areas that looked like they hadn't been trimmed, so I was left thinking, "Huh? Is that it?" I also had no idea what the effects of the shampoo were.
Maybe it's okay if you can flatly refuse? I also think there were more restrictions compared to private salons.

The sales floor is large.
They have a wide selection of snacks and toys.
However, it seems they don't have any specialized clothing, like clothes in …
Awful place and terrible attitude towards the animals kept here. As soon as they get to old if the are not bought I am sure they are euthanized. Adopt don't shop.
This is a great place to restock every year. They have a wide variety of dog supplies and food, and while they don't have as many cat products, they still have a fairly complete selection.

Good pet store. Lot of good quality items. Helpful staff. One of the staff left the counter to come help me find what I was looking for. They didn't have exactly what I wanted buy had something close enough and she helped find it. Lot of good products. Some fun and cute.
